title: Survival Movies
intro: Survival is rarely just about the body. These films dig into what it costs your mind, your morals and your soul.

films.title: Oldboy
films.line: Fifteen years imprisoned with no reason given and freedom feels like a trap.

films.title: The Grey
films.line: A man fights wolves and grief in a frozen wilderness with nothing left to lose.

films.title: Calibre
films.line: One terrible accident in a remote Scottish village and trust becomes the deadliest enemy.

films.title: Burning
films.line: A slow obsession builds until you realize someone may be hunting in plain sight.

films.title: Cargo
films.line: A father races against his own body to find safety for the child he loves.

films.title: A Prophet
films.line: Inside prison walls a young man learns to survive by becoming something far more dangerous.

films.title: The Road
films.line: A father and son push through a scorched, silent world held together by love alone.

films.title: Bone Tomahawk
films.line: A slow-burn rescue mission through brutal frontier darkness that earns every ounce of its dread.

films.title: Prisoners
films.line: Desperation and moral collapse collide as a father takes survival into his own shaking hands.

films.title: Sicario
films.line: She volunteered to find the truth and discovered a war where survival means losing your conscience.
